reliability_html: How reliable is this? On voice generators it had never heard, it caught 78% of fakes and wrongly flagged 7% of real clips (83% and 9% over a simulated phone line). It wrongly flagged none of the real Indian-accented speech it was tested on. But it caught only 2 of 3 clones of one Indian-accented voice, and has not been tested on other languages. Treat the percentage as one signal, not proof. See how well it works.
model_version: v3: retrained on 5,760 clips from many datasets, with whole generators held out. Previous model: model/previous/
